data.name: Naiyyira
data.gender_notes: Naiyyira is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-w-y', which means 'to be gentle, kind, compassionate'. In Islamic tradition, Naiyyira symbolizes the nurturing and caring qualities of a mother and the gentle guidance of a wise mentor. The name Naiyyira carries the meaning “Gentle, Kind, Compassionate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naiyyira usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, kind, compassionate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name deeply rooted in Islamic spirituality, Naiyyira signifies the gentle nurturing and guidance of Allah in one's life.
data.etymology: Naiyyira belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Kind, Compassionate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naiyyira total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Naiyyira highlights the values of tenderness, compassion, and nurturing in Islamic society. It encourages individuals to embody these qualities in their personal interactions, especially towards children, elders, and those in need. The name also reflects the importance of the maternal bond and the mentor-mentee relationship in Islamic tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Naiyyira represents the qualities of a loving, compassionate, and merciful God. It also symbolizes the role of a spiritual guide or mentor, who offers gentle guidance and support in navigating the spiritual journey. The name reminds Muslims of their responsibility to demonstrate kindness and compassion towards other beings, as a way of reflecting the divine attributes within themselves. Therefore, Naiyyira serves as a reminder of the importance of treating others with love, respect, and understanding, and of striving to act with mercy and compassion in their words and actions.
